map.可逆相变或传热过程的熵变等于可逆热量除以温度。: For a reversible phase change or heat-transfer process, the entropy change equals the reversible heat divided by temperature.
map.ΔS = Q_rev / T；水沸点 373.15 K 汽化熵约 11.2 J/: DeltaS = Q_rev / T; at water boiling point 373.15 K the vaporization entropy is about 11.2 J/K.
map.📚 深度解析：可逆过程熵变: Deep dive: Entropy change of a reversible process
map.可逆传热下的熵变 ΔS=Q/T。: Entropy change under reversible heat transfer DeltaS=Q/T.
map.相变（熔化、汽化）熵变计算。: Entropy change for phase transitions (melting, vaporization).
map.与孤立系统熵增原理联动。: Links with the entropy-increase principle of isolated systems.
map.Q=4186 J（1g 水汽化潜热）, T=373.15 K：ΔS=4186/3: Q=4186 J (latent heat to vaporize 1g water), T=373.15 K: DeltaS=4186/373.15=11.22 J/K.
map.可逆相变在恒温 T 下进行，用此绝对温度 K。: A reversible phase change occurs at constant temperature T, so use this absolute temperature in K.
map.不可逆时 ΔS>Q/T，须按可逆路径计算状态函数差。: When irreversible, DeltaS > Q/T; the state-function difference must be computed along a reversible path.
map.可逆过程熵变：ΔS = Q ÷ T（J/K）；联动卡：1/T 卡按 ΔS ÷ Q: Reversible entropy change: ΔS = Q ÷ T (J/K). Linked cards: 1/T is computed directly as 1÷T (1/K); heat recomputation Q = T×ΔS (J); 1/ΔS = 1÷ΔS (K/J), shown as "undefined" when ΔS=0. Validation: Q and T must be finite, T > 0 K; Q may be positive, negative or zero. Criteria: ΔS has the same sign as Q, and |ΔS| falls as T rises.
map.温度必须为正（开尔文温标）；T≤0 时熵变无定义: Temperature must be positive (Kelvin); entropy change is undefined for T ≤ 0
map.请填写可逆热量 Q 与温度 T 后再计算（Q=0 是合法值）。: Enter reversible heat Q and temperature T first (Q = 0 is a valid value).
